sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: hostile AD parameter names and reserved keys are refused
sys_atf_test.description: Caller-supplied attribute keys must be allowlisted. Injection-shaped keys, unknown keys and reserved keys are all refusals, not pass-throughs.

sys_atf_step.description: An injection-shaped parameter name must be refused.
A well-formed but non-allowlisted parameter must also be refused.
P0-2: a caller-supplied Identity must never override the approved target.
P0-3: password material must never be accepted by setPasswordAd.
